cim: Person, Planet, Power: Ecumenical Discernment on Artificial Intelligence. A World Council of Churches Symposium
cim_eredeti: Person, Planet, Power: Ecumenical Discernment on Artificial Intelligence. A World Council of Churches Symposium
szoveg_eredeti:
Churches and ecumenical organizations around the globe have been wrestling with the opportunities, challenges, and impacts of artificial intelligence which is rapidly being integrated in all aspects of life. From individuals and congregations using generative AI in administration and ministry, to activism against bias and environmental destruction, accompanied by theological reflection on what it means to be human – Christians have wrestled with their relationship not only to a particular technology, but to the economic, ecological, and political systems surrounding it.

This intensive symposium aims to learn from significant church and ecumenical responses to artificial intelligence, foster multisector dialogue on key issues, identify critical areas for advocacy and education, and contribute to a comprehensive World Council of Churches response to AI.

A core group of WCC representatives and its partners will consolidate latest developments and strengthen initiatives, drawing on the participation of leaders and thinkers from sectors including theology, ethics, science, technology, business, human rights, and media.

In-person participation by invitation only. Online sessions open to the public will be offered.

For more information, contact [email protected].
